message.content: {"version": "1", "about_items": [{"n": "#287·18", "text": "This is the cloud-like cardigan in a soft camel hue, featuring a relaxed V-neck and large pearl buttons. It is made of a sheer, open-knit fabric that drapes gently over your frame."}, {"n": "#462·06", "text": "The Antigoya Vanity bag is a structured piece in delicate pink, distinguished by a top zipper closure and the classic Givenchy logo plaque on the front."}, {"n": "#390·39", "text": "It is the kimono-style robe shown with its tie belt in a deep green velvet, which brings texture and warmth to the ensemble."}, {"n": "#126·27", "text": "The trousers are cut from soft, creamy white wool, offering a clean and elegant silhouette that elongates your legs."}, {"n": "#57·02", "text": "These ATTICO ankle boots feature rich brown suede with contrasting lighter panels and a thick platform sole, providing comfort for the day."}, {"n": "#501·00", "text": "The RUTA stole displays a striking geometric pattern in cappuccino and ivory tones, crafted from a soft knitted material perfect to drape over your shoulders."}], "named": [{"n": "#287·18", "what": "soft camel knit cardigan"}, {"n": "#462·06", "what": "pink Givenchy Antigona Vanity bag"}, {"n": "#390·39", "text": "green velvet kimono robe"}, {"n": "#126·27", "what": "creamy white wool trousers"}, {"n": "#57·02", "what": "brown suede platform ankle boots"}, {"n": "#501·00", "what": "cappuccino and ivory patterned knitted stole"}], "text": "Your look combines the warmth of autumn with a sophisticated work-appropriate aesthetic, blending textures like camel wool, green velvet, pink leather, and brown suede into one cohesive whole. The soft camel cardigan serves as the perfect neutral anchor, while the white trousers keep the silhouette clean and light. This outfit works beautifully because it balances cozy knits with structured leather and velvet, creating an ensemble that is both professional and comfortable enough for a full day at the office. The palette leans into earthy tones punctuated by the pop of pink in the handbag.", "how_to_wear": ["Tuck the kimono belt loosely into the waistband of your trousers to define your silhouette while keeping the robe draped open over the cardigan.", "Drape the patterned stole casually over one shoulder or tie it lightly around your neck to soften the neckline of the camel knit."], "wrong_photos": [], "swap": {}, "body": "This ensemble works beautifully with your hourglass figure, as the cropped length of the cardigan highlights your waist while the white trousers draw the eye down, elongating your legs. The combination of textures adds dimension without overwhelming your shape.", "makeup": "A soft touch of makeup will help bridge the contrast between the deep velvet green and the lighter tones in your outfit."}
